themes.description: Users consistently report that the app’s verification workflow—particularly the mandatory SMS requirement, unreliable video‑KYC, and excessive permission requests—causes failed FD creation, uncredited withdrawals, and overall frustration. The process feels intrusive, slow, and error‑prone, leading to unmet expectations and distrust.
themes.business_impact: High customer churn risk due to repeated failed transactions; potential regulatory penalties for non‑compliant KYC processes; negative brand perception driving new users away and affecting overall revenue from FD products.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The verification infrastructure is tightly coupled with SMS and video‑KYC services that are either misconfigured or lacking graceful fallbacks. Permission prompts are generic and not contextualized, creating privacy concerns, while error handling for failed KYC is inadequate, preventing clear resolution paths for users.
themes.action_plan: • 1. Remove mandatory SMS requirement for FD setting changes; introduce biometric or OTP fallback. 2. Redesign video‑KYC to pre‑check network and agent availability, provide real‑time status updates, and offer alternative in‑app chat support. 3. Simplify permission requests to only essential data, with clear explanations. 4. Implement automated retry and error‑resolution workflows for failed KYC, including instant credit of funds when KYC is rejected. 5. Create a dedicated KYC support queue with SLA tracking and escalation paths. 6. Conduct a compliance audit of KYC flows and privacy disclosures, updating policy documents accordingly. 7. Roll out a user education campaign detailing each step of verification and troubleshooting tips.

themes.description: Customers consistently report delayed, unresponsive, or ineffective assistance from the support team, leading to frustration and a perception of unhelpful service.
themes.business_impact: High churn risk due to abandonment of service, negative reviews driving potential users away, and possible loss of revenue from users canceling subscriptions or avoiding transactions.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The support operation is likely understaffed and lacking robust training, with insufficient ticket escalation procedures and outdated call‑queue technology resulting in poor response times and repetitive, non‑helpful answers.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct a full audit of support workflows
• Increase staffing and implement shift coverage for peak times
• Deploy a modern ticketing system with priority queues and SLA monitoring
• Provide comprehensive training on product knowledge and customer communication
• Integrate live chat and callback options to reduce call abandonment
• Implement real‑time queue status dashboards for agents
• Collect CSAT data and iterate on response templates
